### 2026-10-10 – I worked on a Starbie project. I created a pcb and a schematic fo it using Kidac, I also wrote edited some codes on Arduino. It was really fun doing it. I added a name for my Starbie and a buzzer modu

**13.2h**

I worked on a Starbie project. I created a pcb and a schematic fo it using Kidac, I also wrote edited some codes on Arduino. It was really fun doing it. I added a name for my Starbie and a buzzer module.
